basic_details.short_information: Maharashtra State Power Generation Company Ltd. (MAHAGENCO) is hiring for 1 post of Consultant - Company Secretary (MNGEPL) on contract basis under Advt. No.08/2026. The post is for Mahagenco NTPC Green Energy Private Ltd, a joint venture between MAHAGENCO and NTPC Green Energy Ltd. Send the application form by post to the Dy. General Manager (HR-RC) in Matunga, Mumbai. It must reach the office on or before 16 November 2026.

qualification.details: MAHAGENCO has 01 post of Consultant - Company Secretary (MNGEPL), Post Code HR01, in the OPEN category. Qualification and experience are counted as on 16 November 2026. | Qualification: Should be Graduate having Membership of Institute of Company Secretaries of India. Age limit: Maximum 38 years (Including Dept. Candidates). The form asks for the age as on 16/11/2026, and the date of birth must be the one on the Secondary School Certificate (SSC/CBSC/ICSE). Remuneration: A consolidated amount of Rs. 1,00,000/- (Rs one lac) per month. Language: Candidates must produce a certificate showing knowledge of Marathi. This can be either a Secondary School Certificate Examination Board or recognised University certificate showing that the candidate passed the Secondary / School certificate Examination, Matric or a Higher Examination of University with Marathi Language, OR a certificate in the enclosed proforma. That certificate must be issued by a Professor of Marathi Language at a College / Institute affiliated to a recognised University, countersigned by the Principal, and state that the candidate can read, write and speak Marathi fluently. | Minimum 02-year post qualification experience in the relevant area in a Govt. Company / Public Sector Undertaking or Private Company. Thorough knowledge of matters pertaining to Company Law, Corporate & Secretarial functions and institutional finance. Well versed with the provisions and regulations of the Companies Act and SEBI rules & regulations. Experience of handling Board matters such as organizing Board & General Meetings, drafting and presentation of Board Memoranda / Agendas & Minutes, listing compliances, drafting and vetting of agreements etc. Those who have worked in group structure involving JVs and subsidiaries shall be preferred. Good drafting, communication skill and liaisoning skills. | Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility for this post. | The appointment is on contract basis for a period of 02 years, with a provision to extend it by one more year on the same rates, terms and conditions. The place of posting is Mumbai. On official tours, the company will reimburse boarding and lodging expenses as applicable in MSPGCL, in addition to Economy class Airfare. No other perks or benefits will be payable. Income Tax will be deducted as per the applicable Income Tax Rules. The Company Secretary gets public holidays as per the MSPGCL calendar year. On top of these, he or she is eligible for one day of leave for every 20 working days including Sundays, which comes to 18 days of leave for one year. During the two-year engagement, either side can end the services with one month's notice in writing. Before leaving, the Company Secretary must hand over all documents related to the engagement to the concerned authorities. Throughout the engagement, the Company Secretary must maintain absolute integrity and do nothing against the interest of the Job / Project / Company.

content_sections.heading: About MAHAGENCO Consultant - Company Secretary (MNGEPL)
content_sections.text: Maharashtra State Power Generation Company Ltd. (MAHAGENCO, also called MSPGCL in the notice) is Maharashtra's state power generation company. Its recruitment office is at Estrella Batteries Expansion Compound, Matunga, Mumbai. This post serves Mahagenco NTPC Green Energy Private Ltd (MNGEPL), a joint venture between MAHAGENCO and NTPC Green Energy Ltd.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Fill in the application in the Proforma printed at the end of Advt. No.08/2026. Keep the same order, preferably typewritten on full-scape paper, and fill in every item properly. Send it to this address so that it reaches on or before 16 November 2026: The Dy. General Manager (HR-RC), Maharashtra State Power Generation Co. Ltd., Estrella Batteries Expansion Compound, Ground Floor, Labour Camp, Dharavi Road, Matunga, Mumbai - 400 019 Write the Post Code (HR01) and the Post applied for clearly on the envelope. Applications received after the due date will not be accepted, and the Company is not responsible for any postal delay. Make sure you have a valid personal email ID and mobile number, and keep both active during the recruitment. Do not give the email ID or mobile number of any other person. If you have no personal email ID, create one before applying. Pay the fee of Rs. 944/- through the MAHAGENCO QR code on the last page of the application. Write your full name and the post applied for on the back of the payment receipt. Fill in the application form and write your name, your father's or husband's name, caste and other details exactly as they appear in your certificates and mark sheets. Affix a recent passport size photograph on the form and sign it. Attach self-attested copies of your certificates for qualification, experience and age, together with the fee receipt and proof of the bank transfer. Send the envelope to the address above so that it reaches on or before 16 November 2026, and keep a copy of the filled form and testimonials for yourself. Pay through the MAHAGENCO QR code (Canara Bank, UPI ID 28935094022329@cnrb, BHIM UPI). The payment proof must show the date of transfer, the amount transferred and the transaction number. Fees in the form of a Pay order, Cash, Demand draft or Money Order will not be accepted. Applications without the correct fee will be rejected. A candidate who pays less than the applicable fee will be held not eligible. Fees once paid will not be refunded in any circumstance, and they will not be held in reserve for any further recruitment. content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: MAHAGENCO has 01 post of Consultant - Company Secretary (MNGEPL), Post Code HR01, in the OPEN category. Qualification and experience are counted as on 16 November 2026. Qualification: Should be Graduate having Membership of Institute of Company Secretaries of India. Age limit: Maximum 38 years (Including Dept. Candidates). The form asks for the age as on 16/11/2026, and the date of birth must be the one on the Secondary School Certificate (SSC/CBSC/ICSE). Remuneration: A consolidated amount of Rs. 1,00,000/- (Rs one lac) per month. Language: Candidates must produce a certificate showing knowledge of Marathi. This can be either a Secondary School Certificate Examination Board or recognised University certificate showing that the candidate passed the Secondary / School certificate Examination, Matric or a Higher Examination of University with Marathi Language, OR a certificate in the enclosed proforma. That certificate must be issued by a Professor of Marathi Language at a College / Institute affiliated to a recognised University, countersigned by the Principal, and state that the candidate can read, write and speak Marathi fluently. Minimum 02-year post qualification experience in the relevant area in a Govt. Company / Public Sector Undertaking or Private Company. Thorough knowledge of matters pertaining to Company Law, Corporate & Secretarial functions and institutional finance. Well versed with the provisions and regulations of the Companies Act and SEBI rules & regulations. Experience of handling Board matters such as organizing Board & General Meetings, drafting and presentation of Board Memoranda / Agendas & Minutes, listing compliances, drafting and vetting of agreements etc. Those who have worked in group structure involving JVs and subsidiaries shall be preferred. Good drafting, communication skill and liaisoning skills. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility for this post. The appointment is on contract basis for a period of 02 years, with a provision to extend it by one more year on the same rates, terms and conditions. The place of posting is Mumbai. On official tours, the company will reimburse boarding and lodging expenses as applicable in MSPGCL, in addition to Economy class Airfare. No other perks or benefits will be payable. Income Tax will be deducted as per the applicable Income Tax Rules. The Company Secretary gets public holidays as per the MSPGCL calendar year. On top of these, he or she is eligible for one day of leave for every 20 working days including Sundays, which comes to 18 days of leave for one year. During the two-year engagement, either side can end the services with one month's notice in writing. Before leaving, the Company Secretary must hand over all documents related to the engagement to the concerned authorities. Throughout the engagement, the Company Secretary must maintain absolute integrity and do nothing against the interest of the Job / Project / Company.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Application form in the given Proforma, with a recent passport size photograph affixed and signed Attested copy of the Secondary School Certificate (SSC/CBSC/ICSE) for Date of Birth Attested copies of certificates in support of educational qualifications Attested copy of the Certificate of experience Certificate showing knowledge of Marathi (school or university certificate, or the proforma certificate) Fee receipt with your full name and the post applied for written on the back, and proof of the bank transfer from the QR code (date of transfer, amount and transaction number) Female candidates who changed their first, middle or last name after marriage: a copy of the marriage certificate and / or the Gazette certificate of name change Anyone whose name differs in any certificate or document: a copy of the Gazette certificate of name change

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in MAHAGENCO Advt. No.08/2026?
faq.answer: There is 01 vacancy for Consultant - Company Secretary (MNGEPL), Post Code HR01, in the OPEN category.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the MAHAGENCO Company Secretary post?
faq.answer: The application must reach the Dy. General Manager (HR-RC) in Matunga, Mumbai, on or before 16 November 2026. Applications received after this date will not be accepted.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for MAHAGENCO Consultant - Company Secretary (MNGEPL)?
faq.answer: The candidate should be a Graduate with Membership of the Institute of Company Secretaries of India. He or she also needs at least 02 years of post qualification experience in the relevant area in a Govt. Company, Public Sector Undertaking or Private Company.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the MAHAGENCO Company Secretary post?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is a maximum of 38 years (Including Dept. Candidates). The age is stated as on 16 November 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of MAHAGENCO Consultant - Company Secretary (MNGEPL)?
faq.answer: The monthly compensation is a consolidated Rs. 1,00,000/- (Rs one lac). No other perks or benefits are payable, apart from boarding and lodging expenses and Economy class Airfare on official tours.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for MAHAGENCO Advt. No.08/2026?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 944/- (Rs.800 Application fee + Rs.144 GST), paid through the MAHAGENCO QR code. Pay order, cash, demand draft and money order are not accepted, and the fee is not refundable.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for the MAHAGENCO Company Secretary post?
faq.answer: Fill in the Proforma at the end of the advertisement and attach a photograph, self-attested certificates and the fee payment proof. Post it to the Dy. General Manager (HR-RC), Maharashtra State Power Generation Co. Ltd., Matunga, Mumbai - 400 019.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for MAHAGENCO Consultant - Company Secretary (MNGEPL)?
faq.answer: Selection is through a Personal Interview, and shortlisted candidates are called for it. The select list is prepared from interview performance and stays operative for 1 year after the result.

faq.question: Q9. Is the MAHAGENCO Company Secretary job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The appointment is on contract basis for 02 years, with a provision to extend it by one more year on the same rates, terms and conditions. Either side can end it with one month's written notice.
